title: dryopteris labordei var. simasakii
intro: Dryopteris labordei var. simasakii, commonly known as a species of fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris labordei var. simasakii are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
